# bioexcel/biobb_cp2k/cp2k_prep

## Summary

Helper bb to prepare inputs for the CP2K QM tool module.

Prepares input files for the CP2K QM tool.

Nextflow adapter of the [Cp2kPrep](https://biobb-cp2k.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cp2k.html#module-cp2k.cp2k_prep) building block of [biobb_cp2k](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_cp2k) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_CP2K_CP2K_PREP } from 'bioexcel/biobb_cp2k/cp2k_prep'

workflow {
    BIOBB_CP2K_CP2K_PREP(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_inp_path` | no | inp, in, txt, wfn | Input configuration file (CP2K run options) |
| `input_pdb_path` | no | pdb | Input PDB file |
| `input_rst_path` | no | wfn | Input restart file (WFN) |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_inp_path` | yes | inp, in, txt | Output CP2K input configuration file |
| `versions_biobb_cp2k` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_cp2k', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Cp2kPrep properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_inp_path: 'inp']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_cp2k container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_CP2K_CP2K_PREP' {
        ext.properties = [simulation_type: 'energy']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `simulation_type` | string | "energy" | Default options for the cp2k_in file. Each creates a different inp file. Values: energy, geom_opt, md, mp2. |
| `cp2k_in` | object | {} | CP2K run options specification. |
| `cell_cutoff` | number | 5.0 | CP2K cell cutoff, to build the cell around the system (only used if input_pdb_path is defined). |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
